newsitem.title: USA: Sustained Japanese surplus bad idea -- Rubin.
newsitem.headline: Sustained Japanese surplus bad idea -- Rubin.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin said Thursday that a sustained current account surplus by Japan "was in nobody's interest."

Speaking to reporters following remarks to a House Appropriations subcommittee, Rubin repeated his belief that the best course for the Japanese economy was to engineer a domestic-led economic expansion.
"The larger question is will Japan have solid growth and domestic demand-led growth?" he said, adding that "in our judgement, that is in the interest of Japan (and) the rest of the world."
Asked about a suggestion that a commission be formed to help deal with a bias in the consumer price index, Rubin said "we have not made a decision with respect to a CPI commission."
